description: Lists the files attached to a document on HTMLRadar (supporting materials a reader can download beside the page): the file name, its size and the attachment id. It returns no file contents and changes nothing. After an add_attachment call that gave no answer, this list shows whether the file was attached.

document_id.description: The document: the document id from list_documents or list_shares.

name: list_attachments
title: List a document's attached files
